# Duck Donald Trump

> Political humor merch. Two T-shirts on the Comfort Colors 1717, a hoodie, three hats, and four stickers: a cartoon rubber duck with an orange combover and a stencil "*uck Donald Trump." Sold in Terracotta, Butter, and White, printed and shipped on demand by Printful. $5 from every shirt, hoodie, and hat, and $1 from every sticker, goes to Democracy Forward Foundation, a 501(c)(3) legal nonprofit.
